name: Touchi Sakura
source:
Profession: Newcomer actress
Hobby: Cake shop tour
Favorite food: Cake, Carbonara
Disliked food: Cauliflower

The youngest of the three sisters, an optimistic and honest lady.
She's a newcomer actress belonging to the 'Iris' agency.
When she participated in a film shooting with her friend, she was suddenly scouted as the leading actress.
She cheerfully works to be the best she can in the acting world.
